<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the Peterson reaction: in the forward direction a Si‑C bond and an alcohol C‑O bond are broken and a C=C double bond is formed. Therefore, I will query for templates that break “trimethylsilyl” and “alcohol” groups and form an “alkene”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "alcohol"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
